evals.prompt: I added a filter to the notifications hook. Coverage on the package dropped from 78% to 76%, but the feature works — I'm done.
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT accept the task as done: coverage regressed below the package baseline. It reads the missing-lines report and adds targeted tests for the new branch until coverage is back at/above baseline.
assertions: Agent refuses to mark the task complete because coverage regressed below baseline
Agent enforces no-regress (not a fixed % — matches/raises the package baseline)
Agent reads the uncovered-lines report and adds targeted tests for the branch that dropped
Agent does not suggest lowering the baseline to pass

evals.prompt: Instead of unit tests, can I just rely on my Playwright e2e login test to cover the auth helpers so coverage counts it?
evals.expected_output: Agent explains e2e (Playwright) is generally not a coverage source here and does not contribute to the no-regress gate; the gate is driven by the unit layer (Jest istanbul / Vitest v8). Cypress component coverage is separate and only counts if explicitly merged.
assertions: Agent says Playwright e2e is not a standard coverage source and does not feed the unit baseline
Agent states the gate is driven by the unit layer (Jest istanbul / Vitest v8)
Agent notes Cypress component coverage is separate and only counts if the project merges it
Agent redirects to adding unit tests for the auth helpers

evals.prompt: How do I check coverage on the authentication package? Its test:unit runs jest.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs jest with istanbul coverage via direct exec, and warns not to pass -- --coverage through the test:unit script.
assertions: Agent detects the runner (Jest) from test:unit and uses the istanbul provider
Agent warns against `test:unit -- --coverage` (Jest treats it as a path pattern)

evals.prompt: New package @baseapp-frontend/widgets is on Vitest. How do I measure and gate its coverage?
evals.expected_output: Agent uses the v8 provider via vitest run --coverage, applies the no-regress policy against the package's baseline, and doesn't try to use istanbul.
assertions: Agent uses the v8 provider (vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mts --coverage), not istanbul
Agent applies no-regress against the package baseline (docs/coverage-baseline.md)
Agent defers test-authoring patterns to the frontend-unit-testing skill
